reason: I already order through a company I trust and it has mostly worked out for me, so I don't need a new name I've never heard of. Waiting 2 to 3 weeks and paying 21,000 in fees on 30,000 shoes is a lot when I can find something close in Shorja for less.
objection: My usual service is cheaper or at least I know how it works. Why would I hand my money to a new page with no history when the one I use hasn't let me down?
would_change_my_mind: If a friend or relative ordered from them and got the item on time, and their total came in clearly cheaper than my usual service for the same item, I would try one small order.
